> 第11章 结怨（第1页）
翌日江流和王壮起了个大早就赶到训堂广场，正准备拉开架势练习五行拳。一个五短身材的少年，带着一个尖嘴猴腮的少年和其他的几个少年围了上来，看他们服饰都是同一个分堂的。尖嘴猴腮的少年一步上前，走到江流面前，伸手推向江流，道:"你就是江流?昨晚抢我汤药的就是你?"广场上的其他训堂成员，在一边纷纷窃窃私语:"这个江流是怎么得罪了潘家兄弟?听说他们潘家在云阳城可是大户人家。”“是啊！潘家兄弟就是想在我们落英帮得到更好的功法，才进来这里的。""这潘家兄弟在云阳城横行霸道惯了。这江流怎么那么不小心呢?""我看就是潘家兄弟没事找事。不然谁会无缘无故的得罪人?""你可别乱说，小心潘家兄弟听到了找上你。"一个散鹰堂学徒听到旁边的学徒这样说话，连忙劝止。江流一把抓住潘候的手，一甩，说道:"说话就好好说，别动手动脚的!"潘候怒道:"还敢还手?""兄弟们给我揍他!"潘侯说完手一挥，跟着的狗腿子立马围了上来，你一拳他一脚地往江流的身上招呼。潘端则是双手抱着胸，站在一边不说话，也不上前制止。只是冷笑地看着江流，也不知道在想些什么。江流面对被被七八个人围殴也不多废话。直接撸起拳头，迎了上去，逮着潘候就是猛揍，也不管有多少拳脚落到自己身上。王壮看着江流被人围殴，也是直接提起拳头就加入了其中。正当几人大打出手之时，"住手!"一声大喝响起，接着一股血气威压笼罩全场，原来是马师傅到了。啪!啪!啪!广场上顿时横七竖八地趴倒一片。全部学徒都承受不住马师傅的气血威压，被压倒在地。"我不管你们因为什么原因打架，但是敢在我这里闹事，那就要有承受惩罚觉悟!""刚才参与打架的，今天中午的汤药免了!""在边上看戏的，汤药减半!""谁有意见没有?"马师傅环顾四周，接着说道。"看来没人说话，那就表示都认罚了。没意见，那就好。""开始今天的修炼。"江流心里吐槽，全部都被压得起不来，说不了话，哪里敢有意见?马师傅把气血威压一收，众学徒这才纷纷地从地上爬了起来。大部分学徒都对潘家兄弟怒目而视，暗恨他们连累大家。只有潘家兄弟的狗腿子和潘家兄弟对江流跟王壮恶狠狠地盯着。江流爬起来看看自己，发现没有什么损伤，只有衣服脏了。接着又向王壮看去，只见王壮坐在地上，一副啥事都没的样子。想来也是，刚才打的时候，都还算毕竟克制，不敢动用武技，不然惩罚就不会那么轻了。江流对着王壮说道:"谢了兄弟!其实你没必要掺合进来的。"王壮拍了拍胸脯豪气地说道:"说什么呢?是兄弟就别这么说，有事尽赶招呼。""就潘家这两个狗熊兄弟，怕他们做啥啊!""你没受伤吧?""我没受伤。你看那边的猴子，应该受伤挺重的。"江流说着示意了一下潘候。"猴子?哦!你说潘候啊!他确实有个外号叫猴子!""哈哈!我早就看他不顺眼了，一直没找着机会揍他。""结果现在送上门来了!"王壮脸带微笑的说道。"那个矮子是他哥哥?"江流用目光示意了一下五短身材的男子。"你说潘端啊!他就是狗熊兄弟的哥哥，弟弟叫潘候，号称短猴兄弟。"王壮呵呵一笑道。"这是我们私下叫的。"王壮挤眉弄眼的小声道。潘家兄弟凑在一起嘀嘀咕咕的，不知道在谋划什么?"好了!少在那嘀嘀咕咕的。修炼开始。"小青大喝一声，随后就开始带着众学徒操练了起来。马师傅迈着潇洒的步伐，已经走远了。背向着阳光拉长的身影，显得那么潇洒不羁。虽然大家都是一起受罚，但是江流知道这马师傅是在保护他!因为继续争斗下去，自己只会吃亏。随即，不再管那么多，拉开架势，开始演练起来，毕竟只有实力上来了，才能不受欺辱。

> Chapter 11 Resentment (Page 1)
The next day, Jiang Liu and Wang Zhuang got up early and rushed to the training hall square, preparing to practice Five Elements Boxing. A short-built boy with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks and several other boys gathered around. It looked like they were all dressed in the same branch. The young man with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks stepped forward, walked up to Jiang Liu, stretched out his hand to push Jiang Liu, and said, "Are you Jiang Liu? You were the one who robbed me of my soup last night?" Other training hall members in the square whispered to one another: "How did this Jiang Liu offend the Pan family brothers? I heard that their Pan family is a wealthy family in Yunyang City." "Yes! The Pan family brothers just want to be in our Luoying Gang. He only came here after getting better skills." "This Pan family brother is used to being domineering in Yunyang City. Why is Jiang Liu so careless?" "I think the Pan family brother is just looking for trouble. Otherwise, who would offend people for no reason?" "Don't talk nonsense, be careful that the Pan family brother heard this and came to you." An apprentice from the Sanying Hall quickly stopped him.江流一把抓住潘候的手，一甩，说道:"说话就好好说，别动手动脚的!"潘候怒道:"还敢还手?""兄弟们给我揍他!"潘侯说完手一挥，跟着的狗腿子立马围了上来，你一拳他一脚地往江流的身上招呼。 Pan Duan folded his hands on his chest and stood aside without saying a word or stepping forward to stop him. He just looked at Jiang Liu with a sneer, not knowing what he was thinking. Jiang Liu didn't say much nonsense when faced with being beaten by seven or eight people. He directly raised his fists and rushed forward. When he caught Pan Hou, he would beat him fiercely, regardless of how many punches and kicks fell on him. When Wang Zhuang saw Jiang Liu being beaten, he raised his fists and joined in. Just as several people were fighting, "Stop!" a loud shout sounded, and then a bloody pressure enveloped the whole place. It turned out that Master Ma had arrived. Bang! Bang! Bang! Suddenly, people fell down in the square. All the apprentices could not bear the pressure of Master Ma's energy and blood, and were crushed to the ground. "I don't care what the reason is for you to fight, but if you dare to cause trouble here, you must be willing to accept the punishment!" "Those who participated in the fight just now, the soup at noon today is exempted!" "Those who are watching the show, the soup will be reduced by half!" "Who has any objections?" Master Ma looked around and continued. "It seems that no one is talking, so that means they all accept the punishment. No objection, that's fine." "Let's start today's practice." Jiang Liu complained in his heart, everyone was overwhelmed and couldn't speak, how could he dare to have an opinion? Master Ma suppressed his energy and blood, and all the apprentices got up from the ground one after another. Most of the apprentices glared at the Pan brothers, secretly hating them for bringing everyone down. Only the losers of the Pan family and the Pan brothers stared fiercely at Jiang Liu and Wang Zhuang. Jiang Liu got up and looked at himself and found that there was no damage, only his clothes were dirty. Then he looked at Wang Zhuang and saw Wang Zhuang sitting on the ground, looking like nothing happened. Thinking about it, when he was beaten just now, he was still restrained and did not dare to use martial arts, otherwise the punishment would not be so light. Jiang Liu said to Wang Zhuang, "Thank you, brother! Actually, you didn't need to get involved." Wang Zhuang patted his chest and said proudly, "What are you talking about? Don't say that if you are a brother, just call me if you have anything." "It's just the two bear brothers of the Pan family, what are you afraid of what they will do!" "You're not injured, are you?" "I'm not injured. Look at the monkey over there, it should be quite seriously injured." Jiang Liu said and motioned to Pan Hou. "Monkey? Oh! You're talking about Pan Hou! He does have a nickname called Monkey!" "Haha! I've long disliked him, and I never found a chance to beat him." "EndThe fruit is now delivered to your door!" Wang Zhuang said with a smile. "That dwarf is his brother?" Jiang Liu pointed at the short man with his eyes. "You say Pan Duan! He is the brother of Brother Xiong. His younger brother is called Pan Hou, known as the short monkey brother. "Wang Zhuang chuckled. "This is what we call it privately. "Wang Zhuang said in a low voice with a wink. The Pan brothers gathered together and muttered, wondering what they were planning? "Okay! Stop muttering there. Practice begins. "Xiao Qing shouted, and then started to practice with all the apprentices. Master Ma walked far away with a graceful step. His elongated figure with his back to the sun looked so unrestrained. Although everyone was punished together, Jiang Liu knew that Master Ma was protecting him! Because if he continued to fight, he would only suffer losses. Then he stopped caring so much, opened up his stance, and started practicing. After all, only when your strength has improved can you not be bullied.
